say:1:1831117001:1.text: You were the one who encouraged me to audition for the Seasong Theater!
say:1:1831117001:1.source_cn: 你不记得了吗？是你鼓励我来海歌剧院应聘演员的！
say:1:1831117001:1.male: You were the one who encouraged me to audition for the Seasong Theater!
say:1:1831117001:1.female: You were the one who encouraged me to audition for the Seasong Theater!

say:2:1831117002:1.text: I did it! I made it! Director Douglas really likes me. He said I can start out as a supporting actress, and if I do well, I'll be the understudy for the lead in his next production!
say:2:1831117002:1.source_cn: 我做到了，我成功了！道格尔导演很看好我，答应让我先从女...
say:2:1831117002:1.male: I did it! I made it! Director Douglas really likes me. He said I can start out as a supporting actress, and if I do well, I'll be the understudy for the lead in his next production!
say:2:1831117002:1.female: I did it! I made it! Director Douglas really likes me. He said I can start out as a supporting actress, and if I do well, I'll be the understudy for the lead in his next production!

say:3:1831117003:1.text: And—I even got Miss Senea's autograph! She even told me I have a natural gift for acting! I never would've dreamed of this!
say:3:1831117003:1.source_cn: 而且——我还拿到了塞涅小姐的签名！她还夸奖我演戏很有天...
say:3:1831117003:1.male: And—I even got Miss Senea's autograph! She even told me I have a natural gift for acting! I never would've dreamed of this!
say:3:1831117003:1.female: And—I even got Miss Senea's autograph! She even told me I have a natural gift for acting! I never would've dreamed of this!

say:4:1831117004:1.text: I never imagined I'd get a second chance at my dream after dying... It's all thanks to you! Thank you so much for believing in me!
say:4:1831117004:1.source_cn: 我从来没想过，死后竟然还有机会实现生前的梦想……这都是...
say:4:1831117004:1.male: I never imagined I'd get a second chance at my dream after dying... It's all thanks to you! Thank you so much for believing in me!
say:4:1831117004:1.female: I never imagined I'd get a second chance at my dream after dying... It's all thanks to you! Thank you so much for believing in me!
